mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen by more than 0.2pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a rise in real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a shift from residential investment to consumer spending, which is associated with a more sustainable economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: demand shift from housing to consumption
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST declines and RSAFS rises simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production above 105 index, the supply chain is robust and corporate margins are stable, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% monthly decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate revenues.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines by more than 0.5% in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which is associated with higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3% monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate output and margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 0.3% in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.1 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.1pp in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
